Ratification by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 between the District and Marsha Rhynes, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide professional development to teachers, working with teachers one-on-one as needed, and leading Cultural Humility PD and facilitated Lesson Planning, Observation of Racial Equity, Parent Liaison Coaching and Leadership
Spiral development, for the period of October 15, 2020 through May 30, 2021, in the additional amount of $20,000.00, increasing the Agreement not to exceed amount from $13,090.00 to $33,090.00. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
headline: Adds $20,000 for teacher professional development at Ralph J. Bunche Academy
summary: This amendment has an individual consultant give teachers professional development at Ralph J. Bunche Academy, including one-on-one work, cultural humility training, lesson planning, and parent liaison coaching. It adds $20,000, raising the cap from $13,090 to $33,090. The period is October 15, 2020 through May 30, 2021. The Board is approving this after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Oakland Kids First - Castlemont High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 between the District and Oakland Kids First, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide opportunities for students to enroll into a paid internship program that provides a career exploration experience to support students in learning about different health and urban design career opportunities, as described in the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, at Castlemont High School, for the period of April 1, 2021 through May 28, 2021, in an amount not to exceed $37,000.00.
headline: Pays Oakland Kids First up to $37,000 for paid career internships at Castlemont High
summary: Oakland Kids First will give Castlemont High School students a chance to join a paid internship that explores careers in health and urban design. The agreement runs from April 1 to May 28, 2021. The cost is capped at $37,000 and comes from Measure N.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
